_doc: Reviewed consumer brands per barcode (docs/ALIASES.md, 4.10): the chains' own brand field is the manufacturer or distributor (על בד / ווטנפס / קימברלי קלארק for the same Huggies wipes), so a brand read from a public product page (chp.co.il, cheapersal.co.il - read-only lookups Naor cleared) replaces it on the product and feeds attrs.brand. Written by a reviewed import, never by the build. A barcode not listed keeps the field majority.
